picks.title: Prime Video Takes Global on Turkish AI-Generated Movie 'Çukur:Vartolu,' a Spin-Off From the Hit Series 'The Pit'
picks.excerpt: Prime Video has taken world rights on 'Çukur:Vartolu,' an AI-generated feature spun off from the Turkish hit series known internationally as 'The Pit' — a major streamer betting on a fully AI-made feature from an existing IP.
picks.rationale: A major streamer acquiring global rights to a fully AI-generated feature built on an established IP is a distribution first, and a different film and buyer from the Baska Sinema story published 09-26.

picks.title: Nicolas Cage Didn't Sign AI Waiver For 'Spider-Noir' & "Probably" Won't Work Again With "AI-Friendly" Amazon
picks.excerpt: At NYCC, Nicolas Cage said he refused to sign an AI waiver for Prime Video's 'Spider-Noir' and probably won't work with the 'AI-friendly' streamer again — a performer-likeness flashpoint in AI production deals.
picks.rationale: A star publicly refusing an AI likeness waiver brings performer consent clauses in production contracts into the open, and it is new news.

picks.title: Generative AI Still Needs Artists' Judgment, Says Netflix's Eyeline GenFX Chief James Rustad at Busan
picks.excerpt: At Busan's ACFM, Eyeline's James Rustad mapped Netflix's generative-AI VFX workflow, saying artists still decide which generated shots serve the story.
picks.rationale: The single Busan ACFM pick, chosen because it lays out a concrete studio workflow: Netflix's in-house GenFX pipeline and where artists make the decisions.

picks.title: 모픽, '3D 씬'으로 영상 구도·카메라 연출 직접 다룬다
picks.excerpt: 모픽이 AI 영상의 연출 무작위성과 구도 붕괴를 해결하는 3D 장면 연출 에디터 '3D 씬'을 출시했다 — 3D 마네킹과 카메라로 구도를 먼저 잡고 생성한다.
picks.rationale: A new tool release that fixes a real AI video problem: you block the composition and camera with 3D mannequins before generating. It is the most hands-on pick for creators.

picks.title: Latvian filmmaker wins AI film Grand Prix in Kazakhstan
picks.excerpt: The first Astana AI Film Festival wrapped with Latvian filmmaker Nikolay Shestak taking the €400,000 Grand Prix from 8,000+ entries; the €1.8M fund splits prizes and investment in AI film projects.
picks.rationale: A concrete event: the first Astana AI Film Festival named its €400K Grand Prix winner from 8,000+ entries. It shows the AI-film prize and funding circuit growing outside Hollywood.
